fusions.name: Barbed Parting
fusions.desc: Costs 5% of your maximum health. A weapon strike that leaves a barbed stinger in the target: the sting deals 9 damage and keeps pumping, leaving it [Poisoned] for 3 damage a second for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Alarm Scent
fusions.desc: Looses 4 stingers in a spread out to 6 tiles. Each stinger deals 3 damage, with a 40% chance to leave its target [Marked] for 8 seconds. The mark can spread on its own to up to 2 more enemies within 4 tiles.

fusions.name: Kicked Hive
fusions.desc: For 8 seconds, 30% of the damage you take is dealt back to whoever dealt it, and they are stung: [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Sentry of the Comb
fusions.desc: A bonded hive sentry fights beside you, stinging an enemy within 4 tiles every 1.2 seconds. Each sting deals 3 damage and leaves the target [Poisoned] for 1 damage a second for 4 seconds.
